caption: The drawing shows a folded piece of woven fabric composed of a grid pattern with alternating squares in blue, light gray, cream, red, and maroon tones. Each square features an embroidered or woven star-shaped or floral geometric design in contrasting colors. The fabric has a fringe along the lower and right-side edges, where the threads are loose and splayed. The blue squares have patterns in navy or cream, the cream and gray squares have blue or red patterns, and the red squares have designs in lighter or yellowish shades. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and there is a small, separate square of blue with a cross pattern in the bottom right corner outside the main fabric.
title: Economy Scarf
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
